phaseTitle: What would you like to enroll your child for?
phaseDescription: Select the period in which your child should receive care. In the next step, enter contact details, child details and the care offers you want.
disabled: Online enrollment is currently not enabled for this school. Please contact the OGS if you would like to submit an enrollment.
noPhase: No enrollment phase is currently open. Please check again later or contact the OGS if you expected a deadline.
chooseOfferText: Choose the right care offer for your child. Check the care period and enrollment deadline.
submitText: Have contact details, date of birth, grade level and desired care offers ready. Required fields are marked in the form.
statusText: After submitting, your status page opens. Save the link or confirmation email so you can access it later.
formDescription: Please fill in all required fields. If you want to enroll multiple children, you can add them directly in this form.
parentEmbeddedDescription: Check the prefilled data and add any missing information. After submitting, you can see the status directly in the parent portal and will also receive a confirmation by email.
detailsLoadFailed: The details could not be loaded. You can still fill in the form.
oneFormText: This enrollment only applies to the displayed care period. Please start another enrollment for a different period.
emailText: Use an email address where you can be reached reliably. Questions, decisions and the status link will be sent there.
reviewText: The OGS reviews your information after submission. An online enrollment is therefore not a final place confirmation yet.
statusAfterSubmitText: After submitting, you will automatically go to the status page. There you can see whether the enrollment was received, is being reviewed or has been decided.
submittedTitle: Thank you. Your enrollment has been submitted.
submittedText: A confirmation email with the status link is on its way. You can use the link at any time to view the current status.
